subject: Future Tech
title: Regulation and Legal Frameworks
description: Learn Regulation and Legal Frameworks in one minute.

hook.text: A self-driving car crashes. Who's liable: the owner, the software company, or the car manufacturer?

buildup.text: AV regulation is a patchwork. California allows robotaxis. Arizona is AV-friendly. New York effectively bans them.

discovery.text: The EU's AI Act classifies AVs as high-risk AI requiring safety certifications, testing, and human oversight plans.

twist.text: Too little regulation risks public safety. Too much regulation slows deployment.

climax.text: Federal AV legislation has stalled in the US Congress since 2017.

punchline.text: The technology is ahead. The law is still catching up.

quiz.question: Why is AV regulation challenging in the US?
options: Too few companies are building AVs
Federal legislation stalled; states have conflicting rules
The technology changes too slowly for regulators
